subject: [PATCH v3 3/7] selftests/mm: check that MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT reject hugetlb

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to the Linux selftests suite to verify that the MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT hints are rejected when applied to hugetlb memory. The test checks that madvise(2) fails with EINVAL for a hugetlb VMA, as these hints cannot be applied to such memory. The patch also includes changes to reserve a hugetlb page for the test when run as root and restore the pool on exit.
